warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor rewrite review for Lessons 0014–0020 after activity-variety, load, naturalness and skill-mix revisions; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Room-number choices and short confirmations are natural for a community-center booking context.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked learner-facing Persian for meaning, clarity and current Nova orthography rules; wording stays colloquial and context-specific.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson adds room/one/two while reusing or; the reading card makes the number meaningful rather than isolated.

distractorQuality.evidence: Reading and choice distractors contrast room numbers and an unrelated location without relying on punctuation tricks.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Iris offers two rooms for a small program and Nina chooses one; the exchange fits their established community-center roles.

difficultyFit.evidence: Three concrete target words and one familiar choice pattern keep the load appropriate for early A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Room language appears in a label, dialogue, choice and hidden response with different demands.

transferQuality.evidence: or transfers from drinks to rooms and reading is added before production.

overallCoherence.evidence: Every task serves recognizing or selecting a room number.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review only. Activity order is more varied and help/feedback paths are present, but no real learner, microphone, timing or retention test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio still requires perceptual/prosody review with human listeners.
Hidden-answer retrieval remains bounded and cannot certify open-ended language ability.
